reasons: The original Slurm job required 1 GPU (`--gres=gpu:1`) but the Flux resource section does not request any GPU resources; on GPU-managed systems this can allocate CPU-only resources and the job may fail or run slower.
The original Slurm job requested memory per CPU (`--mem-per-cpu=4G`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this can under-provision the job.

The original Slurm job used a reservation (`--reservation=gpuprimer`) but the Flux resource section has no reservation selection; this may prevent use of the intended reserved resources and change scheduling/eligibility.
